what_happened: cflags_game (-O2 -fno-strength-reduce) did not match geomlib: register choices and strength-reduced loops differ
cause: -fno-strength-reduce was measured on SND code (0x803B3908), and -O2 and -Os compile the other test function identically
fix: geomlib builds with -Os -G0 -ffloat-store; game-wide flags to settle on the next units

what_happened: dtk refused the unit's vtable in its .data range (cyclic link order)
cause: SN's linker put every .gnu.linkonce.d vtable after all .data (0x806492A8..0x80686800), behind the libraries
fix: tools/linkonce_data.py: the object links against the vtable left in the .data asm

what_happened: an inline accessor (GeomGroup::Child) was emitted out of line and shifted .text by 0x10
cause: GCC 2.95 emits a class's inline members where its vtable is; ngcld dead-stripped unused ones
fix: GameObject runs strip_unused --gcc as SN's libraries do

what_happened: one header edit went through a shell python replace (no backslash was lost, checked)
fix: editor tools only for C and headers

what_happened: rule 6 (no lbl_ left in a DONE unit) cannot hold for an anonymous string literal (lbl_805E5524, the __FILE__ path)
cause: EA's source gives it no name
fix: needs an owner rule: exempt literals or name them by convention

what_happened: objdiff reports the unit's .rodata as 0 matched though main.dol is OK
cause: objdiff pairs data by symbol and ProDG literals have none (same on libc/SND units)
